description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, drug or intervention, sponsor or words, filtered by status (open by default), phase and country; or give an NCT id for one study with its full eligibility criteria. Each study: status, phases, sponsor, enrollment, age and sex limits, dates, primary outcomes, site count by country and sites in the country asked. Up to 20 per call, most recently updated first. Data: US National Library of Medicine. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

country.description: Country or city with a site (Germany, Boston)

nct.description: One study by id, with eligibility criteria (NCT06283927)

status.description: open (default), any, or a comma list: recruiting, not-yet-recruiting, active, enrolling, completed, terminated, withdrawn, suspended

name: clinical_trials_search
